checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Frames are square 640x640 across a 5s clip; silence is stated and not contradicted, though audio can't be heard.
Same robot design, style and pot throughout.

must.item: Yellow body, single eye, purple boots consistent
must.why: Eye and boots stay consistent. The eye is partly hidden by the can and the head shifts, but the design holds.

must.item: Can visibly tips and water flows onto seedlings
must.why: At 2s and 3.5s the can tips and water streams onto the seedlings. The can is briefly a blob at 0.5s.
The flat 2D cartoon look is kept.

faults.what: At 0.5s the red watering can is a crumpled blob, not a clear can shape.
The tipped can covers the robot's eye at 2s and 3.5s. Its head tilts and the body leans oddly. The arms are vague and the can handle is awkward.
The ending frame at 4.8s has the can upright and held in front of the body. It looks different from the start, and the spout points away from the plants.

summary: The animation keeps the robot and the cartoon style and shows a clear tip-and-pour onto the seedlings. The can looks mushy in the first frame, and the can hides the eye during the pour.
